audit.why: Heavily Naafiri-favored (54.16% WR, both chart layers Naafiri x7, FAVOURED 4/10): TF has no self-peel beyond Flash and Gold Card. Chart layers already agree — no chart edits needed.
Spikes 3-5 (pack burst vs cardless farmer), 6 (all-in before card lock), first item (one-combo kill), late (deny Destiny picks) — all four present and accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content 'early' labels Wild Cards as (W) — it is TF's Q. whys[1] calls Naafiri's W a 'dash' — it is an untargetable pack empower with move speed, not a dash. Full-layer 'W lock-on dive' language recurs. The auto-reset tell on Pick a Card (his combo opens with a W-buffered auto — the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue) was unstated.
audit.why: Kit authority: TF Q = Wild Cards 6s rank 1, W = Pick a Card 6s flat with autoReset flag, R = 170/140/110. The gold card is the only stun and it telegraphs by glowing.
audit.corrected: Slot letters fixed, W described as speed burst, auto-reset tell added to cooldowns, real numbers inserted.

edits.after: You out-stat him at every level 1-2; his Wild Cards (Q) can poke slightly but he has no way to stop your Packmate burst, so trade whenever he walks up to farm.

edits.before: At 2 your W dash and second point let you punish him last-hitting freely.
edits.after: At 2 your W speed burst and second point punish him last-hitting freely.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Check it before every step-up. - E Eviscerate is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): 6s flat, and it opens with an auto-reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back the moment it glows yellow. - Destiny is 170/140/110s: one used R buys minutes of safe side waves. - Your E is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.
